questions.name: department
questions.instructions: Which team should handle this support message? Use only observable cues in the text. Do not invent account facts.

questions.name: duplicate_charge
questions.instructions: Does the message describe being charged twice for the same purchase or duplicate billing?

questions.name: escalate_now
questions.instructions: Should a human agent take over immediately (legal threat, repeated failed bot help, or explicit demand for a person)?

questions.name: refund_tool_safe
questions.instructions: Is it reasonable to allow an automated refund tool now (clear duplicate charge or obvious billing error stated in the message)?

questions.name: urgency
questions.instructions: How urgent is this issue for the customer?

levels.label: Low
levels.description: Minor inconvenience; workaround exists or cosmetic issue.

levels.label: Medium
levels.description: Important task impaired but partial workaround exists.

levels.label: High
levels.description: Critical task blocked with no workaround.
